description.text: Public relations specialists verify data, write press releases, respond to media, and update websites and social platforms. See O*NET 27-3031 tasks, US 2025 wages, BLS 2025–2035 projections, and the release authorization boundaries.

subject.name: Public Relations Specialists
subject.summary: Public relations specialists shape and maintain the public image of an organization or individual, verify data, write press releases and media Q&A, respond to media information requests, update website and social platform content, and maintain community and media relationships. Important statements, sensitive data disclosure, and organizational commitments are approved by authorized personnel.
